label: every step in the browser: request, payment approved in the Qlyphs wallet extension, find, ML-DSA-65 withdrawal, 2-of-3 release
what: /bridge/quantum hosted at https://qlyphs-pqroute-app.qlyphs.workers.dev (feat/pq-route, testnet settings) on bridge qtc-pq. Recipient (a browser without any wallet) made the encrypted request; the sponsor opened its fresh account with one ML-DSA-65 key before the link existed. Payer: the Qlyphs wallet extension built from the same branch in its testnet configuration (development identity, a fresh wallet funded by the curve faucet), loaded in a separate Chromium profile. Three wallet prompts were approved in the extension's own windows: connect, send 1 QTC to the lock, and the site session whose nonce is SHA-256 of the route. Minted into NEAR Intents; the recipient's browser found it from its route backup, withdrew with an ML-DSA-65 signature made in the page, and two of three attesters released it on Quantus.
found_by_this_run: the wallet refused the route challenge sent as bare hex (its parser takes canonical 0x hex) and a resumed payment reused an expired challenge; both fixed in feat/pq-route 8cd4665d, then the same payment was resumed (no second transfer) and settled.

wallet.build: apps/extension, QLYPHS_EXTENSION_NETWORK=switchable with a testnet whose dapp origins include the hosted app

delivered: intents (read by the page from the mint's own receipts)
